From: Neha Kapoor <neha@kavyafashions.com>
To: fiftyfive-tech consulting
Date: April 18, 2026
Subject: StyleMart — decisions from our side

Hi,

Following up with answers to your open questions. These are final decisions.

1. MULTI-VENDOR — DECIDED: No.
   StyleMart is Kavya Fashions only. We are not a marketplace.
   Please remove multi-vendor from scope entirely.

2. MOBILE APP — Both web and app, launched together.
   Our MD is firm: we want customers to download an app AND access via web.
   Whatever the tech choice, both must be ready at the same time.

3. LOYALTY POINTS — Confirmed in scope.
   Rules: earn 1 point per ₹100 spent. Redeem: 100 points = ₹50 discount.
   Points expire after 12 months of account inactivity.

4. COD — Confirmed essential.
   We estimate 60–70% of orders will be COD at launch. Design for this.

5. TIMELINE — Soft launch by end of October 2026 (before Diwali, which is October 20).
   Full launch: Q1 2027 (web + app + full catalog).

6. BUDGET — Priya Sharma (CFO) will share approved numbers separately.
   Do not include budget figures in any shared document until NDA is signed.

— Neha Kapoor
Head of Marketing, Kavya Fashions Pvt Ltd
